verdict.rationale: Pylon ships several built-in AI assistants that users can hand work to. The Assist Agent can be messaged to investigate issues, draft replies and perform actions. Background Agents run asynchronous work, and issues can be assigned to the AI agent the same way you would assign a teammate. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
You can also assign an individual issue to your AI agent, the same way you might normally assign an issue to a team member.
Set up agents that do work for you in the background, preparing investigations on incoming issues before you arrive.
The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.
